name: file_service.py
summary: Handles file operations for dataset management including storage, naming, and path resolution
purpose: Provides centralized file handling logic for the dataset application, abstracting filesystem operations and ensuring unique, secure file storage through UUID-based naming and configurable storage paths
responsibilities: Managing file uploads and storage for datasets
Generating unique filenames using UUIDs to prevent collisions
Resolving file system paths via Django settings
Abstracting OS-level file operations from domain logic
inputs: File objects or raw file paths
Django settings configuration for storage paths
architecture_notes: Implements the Service Layer pattern to isolate file I/O concerns from domain models and API controllers. Uses Django settings for path configuration and UUID for collision-resistant naming, indicating a design favoring configurability and safe concurrent uploads. Positioned within the dataset services layer alongside dataset_service.py, suggesting it is likely composed or invoked by the higher-level dataset orchestration service rather than directly by views, promoting loose coupling and single-responsibility at the service tier.
improvements: Introduce a storage backend abstraction to support cloud storage (S3, GCS) beyond local filesystem
Add explicit file validation (type, size, integrity checks) before storage operations
Implement async file processing or chunked uploads for large dataset files
Add comprehensive error handling with custom exceptions instead of propagating raw OS errors
Inject settings dependency via constructor rather than direct module import to improve testability and adhere to dependency inversion
